media.title: Karl Michael May — Universal Filmlexikon, 1932
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the composer Karl Michael May, head turned to the side.
media.publicCaption: Karl Michael May, who composed with Kaper the songs recorded here, in the portrait printed beside his entry in the Universal Filmlexikon of 1932.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unnamed; Universal Filmlexikon 1932, edited by Frank Arnau (Berlin: Universal Filmlexikon G.m.b.H.; London: London General Press), p. 80.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The portrait was printed in a German reference work of 1932 and names no photographer, so no term can be computed from a photographer’s death; read as an anonymous work, its German term of seventy years from publication was still running on the United States restoration date of 1 January 1996, and the URAA restored United States copyright. A reduced-resolution reproduction (520 × 695 px, from 840 × 1123 px) is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator.
